name: zei231-registro
description: Answers questions on the Italian Modello 231 (Legislative Decree 231/2001) with sourced facts and builds the company's 231 register from the chat: profile, risk assessment of the Administration process, offence families, proposed protocols, and a quote request to the partner consultancy CO.DE.

interface.longDescription: ZEI 231 helps an Italian company, or a group of companies, start its Modello 231 under Legislative Decree 231/2001 from a conversation. Three skills answer general questions (what the Model is, who must adopt it, offence families, supervisory body, code of ethics, whistleblowing, structure) from legal texts checked against Normattiva on 09/10/2026; where the law is silent or debated, the answer says so. The fourth skill uses the ZEI 231 tools: the user creates the group and the company profile, then maps the Administration process. ZEI 231 shows 12 sensitive activities and preselects the likely ones from the ATECO code. For each activity that the user keeps, it shows the offence families and a proposed control protocol. The result is a draft in the group register. From the chat, the user can open the ZEI 231 dashboard with a one-time link and ask the partner consultancy CO.DE for a quote; the request is sent only after the user agrees. The first mapping is an automatic analysis. It is not legal advice. The service is in Italian. Sign-in uses OAuth with PKCE. Data stays in the EU (Frankfurt), except for the providers that the privacy notice lists.
